item.description: This week, the SonicWall Capture Labs Threat Research Team reviewed a sample of WardenStealer malware. WardenStealer is highly evasive and uses multiple types of obfuscation, encoding, and indirect calls to prevent analysis, monitor the system and exfiltrate data. In addition, Java library use means the binary is loaded as a DLL instead of a normal PE file when run.

item.title: IntelliCom NetBiter Hostname Buffer Overflow (Dec 22, 2009)
“Remember the Name: DARK KURD” - A Destructive Ransomware and Stealer Horror Themed Threat
item.description: SonicWall Capture Labs threat researchers have identified "Dark Kurd" — a destructive, multi-stage threat that combines ransomware, a Telegram-controlled RAT, credential stealer, keylogger, worm, and aggressive system sabotage into a single native 64-bit PE binary. Disguised as a Kurdish horror game ("KurdishHorror.exe"), the malware operates as a dropper that, upon execution, systematically disables all security defenses, destroys recovery infrastructure, encrypts files with AES-256, establishes Telegram bot C2, replicates itself across the filesystem and network, and deploys a full-featured PowerShell RAT capable of screen capture, keylogging, credential theft, and arbitrary command execution.
